description: Official Topic 19 grounded technical-pattern thresholds. Values are default engineering parameters and can be adjusted to the sponsor's business definition without changing compiler code.

close_together.description: Two numeric indicators are considered close together when their relative distance is within 3% of the larger absolute value.

reset.description: A pullback/reset is grounded as the left indicator being near the target line within 2%, with at most 0.5% downside tolerance below the line.
